prompt:
I need the front end for Reelcall. A personal alert service for repertory-film fans that watches the schedules of local independent cinemas and tells you when films you want to see on the big screen are showing or selling out.

Who's using it: Jonah, a 29-year-old public-library archivist who goes to two or three repertory screenings a month and especially cares about 35mm and 70mm prints. He checks the service on his own time, usually on the train home.

What they're doing right now: He just got an alert that a 35mm print of Stalker this Saturday at the Lumen Theatre is 80% sold. He's deciding whether to buy now or wait for the Sunday showing. At the same time he's annoyed that he got 14 alerts this week, mostly about digital screenings of films he's already seen, and a midnight-movie series he doesn't care about. He wants to keep being interrupted for rare prints and nearly sold-out shows of films he hasn't seen, and get everything else in a weekly roundup.

What's in the system at this point: 6 cinemas he follows (Lumen Theatre, The Avalon Rep, Cinemateca North, Parkside Microcinema, University Film Society, Grand Lake 70mm). 214 films he wants to see, 61 of them marked 'must see on film', plus 389 films marked already seen. 38 upcoming matching screenings over the next 6 weeks, each with film, cinema, date and time, format (35mm, 70mm, DCP, 16mm), seats sold out of capacity (e.g. Stalker, Sat Nov 21 7:30 p.m., 35mm, 142/178 sold; Sun Nov 22 3:00 p.m., 61/178), series name and ticket price. Alert history for the past 30 days: 47 alerts, broken down by reason (new screening added, selling fast, last showing, format upgrade). Current rules: alert on any screening of a wanted film, selling-fast threshold 70%, quiet hours 11 p.m.–7 a.m.

Build it as a working web app, opened in the state that person would see at that moment. No backend: use realistic mock data (no lorem ipsum, no placeholder names), and make the interactive parts actually work client-side.

Use whatever framework and tooling you like. When you're done there must be a static production build in ./out with ./out/index.html as the entry point. It will be served from the root of a plain static file server (no rewrites, no server code) and viewed in a desktop browser at 1440×900.
